cards.text: Chronicles has been tracing the families of Israel's sons (1 Chronicles 2:1), and now it turns to the clans of Judah. Name after name comes through, like Perez, Hezron, Hur, and Ashhur the father of Tekoa with his two wives.

Then the list slows down for one man, Jabez, more honorable than his brothers, whose mother named him Jabez, saying, "Because I bore him in pain." Jabez calls out to the God of Israel to bless him, enlarge his territory and keep him from harm so he'll be free from pain, and God grants his request. After that the clans roll on, with Mered's wife Bithiah, Pharaoh's daughter, a town named for its craftsmen, and clans of linen workers and potters. These families are known for what they MADE, and my one skill for years in that junk drawer was collecting DUST.

Next comes the line of Simeon, another of Israel's sons (1 Chronicles 2:1), with towns like Beersheba and Ziklag. Shimei has sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers don't have many children, so the clan never gets as numerous as Judah's. Twenty-two children, friend, and I looked after six little cookie cutters and STILL needed a nap. And the clan leaders listed by name see their families increase greatly.

cards.question: The Simeonites journey to the entrance of Gedor, on the east side of the valley. They're searching for ___ for their flocks.
When the Simeonites reach Gedor, they find only thin, poor pasture.
Besides the good pasture at Gedor, how does the record describe the land itself?

cards.text: Some Hamites had lived there before. In the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, the men named in that record come and attack the Hamites in their dwellings and the Meunites who were there, devoting them to destruction.

cards.question: After the attack at Gedor, what do the Simeonites do?

answers.text: They give the land to Judah

cards.text: And that's not the end of it. Five hundred Simeonites head out, led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

cards.question: Where do the five hundred Simeonites go?

cards.text: At Mount Seir, they strike down the remnant of the Amalekites who had escaped.

cards.question: The five hundred Simeonites settle at Mount Seir and are still living there when this record is written.
